what: The test that every key `store` writes is in `front_keys`/`filing_keys` never saw two of the three front keys written: pages and item pages are written only when the store says `paged()`, which defaults to false and no test store of the crate set. Its planted-bug control (the list less the pages key) therefore found nothing outside the list.
cost: one failed control in the first run; a few thousand tokens to find the switch
cause: a record kind behind a default-off switch, and an invariant test that did not check the kinds it claims to cover were written
class: vacuous success: an invariant over a set that was empty for the case it names
prevention: the invariant test now runs a paged leg and asserts every `front_keys` kind was written before it checks the lists
